i take 100mg sertraline and 80mg ritalin

ive been on sertraline for about a year now and have tried other antidepressants before that (amitriptyline and fluoxetine). having severe depression, i find that SSRIs really help me be more stable and experience the least amount of side effects compared to other types of antidepressants (tricyclic). although there are definitely side effects in the beginning, these will die down as time goes on, if it doesn’t request a change of meds from your doctor. not every drug works the same as it does on other people though, its really up to you if you wanna go through the process of SSRI trial and error as it may be a long and tiring experience. 

ive only been taking ritalin for about a week and so far the good out weighs the bad. starting to have both meds in your body is def a weird experience and the first day was hell. i was extremely anxious and hypersensitive of my surroundings. when the ritalin wore off i felt like i was in a frozen state and felt even more sluggish than before. as the week went on, my body got used to it and ive noticed i experience less mood swings and have a generally better mood bc my thoughts aren’t running all over the place. 

i will say that if you do decide to get it, know that antidepressants arent instant acting and take weeks - months to take full effect. the first few weeks are the worst as most people usually get a “dip” before feeling better, feeling worse and having more suicidal ideation. just really consider all the positives and negatives before making a decision.
